name: Marry The Wrong Bride
overview: Determined to escape an arranged marriage, Bianca Anderson persuades her twin sister, Camilla, to take her place at the altar. But after seeing the handsome Angelo de Rossi, Bianca immediately regrets her decision and sets out to win him back. As jealousy, deception, and family secrets spiral out of control, a shocking scandal drives Angelo closer to Bianca, while Camilla discovers the truth behind her sister’s betrayal. What begins as a desperate scheme soon turns into a fierce battle for love, revenge, and the future of the powerful Rossi family.
